You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: What was the total distance covered for climbing activities in the OpenTracks app from October 05 2023 to October 11 2023? Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "OpenTracks"}. Opened the OpenTracks app successfully; the track list is now visible showing various activities. I need to find climbing activities between Oct 5-11, 2023. I can see "Climbing Session" from Yesterday with 10.23 mi, but I should use the aggregated stats button (bottom left) or filter by date/category to get accurate climbing totals for the specified date range.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 5}. Clicked the aggregated stats button at bottom-left, which opened the Aggregated Stats screen showing all-time stats by activity type (CLIMBING: 20.43 mi across 4 tracks, TRAIL RUNNING, TRAIL HIKING, SKIING). However, these are totals, not filtered by the Oct 5-11, 2023 date range yet—I need to click the Filter button (index 4) to apply the date filter.
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 4}. Clicked the Filter button on the Aggregated stats screen, which opened a Filter dialog with activity type checkboxes (all checked) and a date field showing "Sunday, October 15, 2023" as the From date; next I need to set the date range to Oct 5-11, 2023 and possibly uncheck non-climbing activities (though the climbing row distance 20.43 mi will still be shown individually regardless).
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked on the "From" date field (currently showing "Sunday, October 15, 2023") to open a date picker and change it to October 5, 2023, but the screen doesn't appear to have changed - the date picker may not have opened. I may need to try clicking again or the date picker might appear as an overlay that wasn't captured in the UI elements.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "Thursday, October 5, 2023", "index": 2}. Attempted to input "Thursday, October 5, 2023" into the From date EditText field (index 2), but the screenshot shows no change - the date field still displays "Sunday, October 15, 2023". The input_text action likely didn't work on this date field because it opens a date picker dialog rather than accepting direct text input. Next, I should click the date field to open the date picker and navigate to October 5, 2023 instead.
Step 6: Action selected: {"action_type": "long_press", "index": 2}. Long-pressed the "From" date EditText field (showing "Sunday, October 15, 2023") to try to bring up edit options, but the screen did not change—long press had no visible effect. I should instead try clicking it to open a date picker dialog to change the From date to October 5, 2023.
Step 7: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked the "From" date field (index 2) to open the date picker for filtering by date range, but the screen did not change - the date picker did not open. May need to try a different approach, such as long-pressing the field or tapping more precisely. Note: Aggregated stats showed CLIMBING total all-time = 20.43 mi across 4 tracks; need to identify which climbing tracks fall within Oct 5-11, 2023.
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked Cancel on the filter dialog, which closed it and returned to the Aggregated stats screen showing current filter results (Climbing: 20.43 mi across 4 tracks). The date range may not match Oct 5-11, 2023 yet - need to reopen filter and set correct date range to get accurate climbing distance for that week.
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked "Navigate up" (index 3) to exit the Aggregated stats screen and return to the track list; now I can see individual tracks with dates - need to identify climbing activities between Oct 5-11, 2023. Note from prior screen: CLIMBING aggregated stats showed 4 tracks totaling 20.43 mi, but I need only those in the Oct 5-11 range, not all climbing tracks.
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "scroll", "direction": "down", "index": 4}. Scrolled down on the track list to find more climbing activities, but the screen content didn't change - the list appears to not have scrolled (same items visible from Casual Walk to Cycle Trip on 7 Oct). I should try scrolling again or use a different approach like using the aggregated stats with date filtering, or check the bottom-most visible track (Cycle Trip on 7 Oct) which is within the date range.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 5}. Clicked on the aggregated stats button (index 5) which navigated from the track list to the Aggregated stats screen showing all-time totals by activity type; CLIMBING shows 4 tracks totaling 20.43 mi all-time, but this is not filtered by date (Oct 5-11, 2023) yet — need to click the Filter button (index 4) to apply date range.
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 4}. Clicked the Filter button on the Aggregated stats screen, which opened the Filter dialog showing activity type checkboxes (all checked) and a "From" date field currently showing "Sunday, October 15, 2023". Need to set the date range to Oct 5-11, 2023 by tapping the From date field.
Step 13: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked on the "From" date field (index 2) to open the date picker, but the screen didn't change - the date picker dialog did not open. The filter dialog still shows all activity types checked. Need to try a different approach, perhaps long-press or tap more precisely on the date text.
Step 14: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked Cancel on the filter dialog to close it and return to the aggregated stats screen, which now shows all activities including CLIMBING with 4 tracks totaling 20.43 mi. Next, I need to view individual climbing tracks to filter by date range Oct 5-11, 2023, since the date filter approach wasn't working well.

General

- If the desired state is already achieved (e.g., enabling Wi-Fi when it's already on), you can just complete the task.
